mission: Implement a durable surface/root registry with stable IDs, aliases, known public routes, owner/context/change-thread pointers, local planner/steward refs and privacy/authority class. Unknown routes must remain unresolved, never guessed.
selection_reason: After repeated live races on the top four lanes, selected the highest-value independent compatible READY lane with lower collision risk. A stable surface registry is foundational for local page routing, Control Room projection and multi-surface integration.
